answer_1.quote: RecInter pioneered the use of LLM agents to simulate diverse user activities on a platform.
answer_1.outputs: simulated user actions such as liking, reviewing, or purchasing items, and generating textual reviews

answer_2.quote: Based on the correctness of the agents' selections, we compute evaluation metrics such as Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and F1 Score.

answer_3.quote: Following prior work, we adopt a pairwise evaluation strategy using a Judge Agent (GPT-4o).

answer_4.quote: We randomly selected a subset of 30 distinct pairs of agent simulation samples. These pairs were presented to three human evaluators with expertise in agent-based simulation.
answer_4.guideline: assess which sample in the pair demonstrated more realistic behavioral logic and better alignment with the associated user profile.
criteria: alignment with the associated user profile
